messages.content: Read the customer messages in chronological order. Record the latest cancellation intent using one native update_cancel_goal call. Later corrections override earlier scope. Identity or reason answers do not cancel an earlier request. For all_pending or none use an empty order_ids list. For selected use only exact order IDs the customer supplied. source_quote must quote the customer message establishing the latest scope. Never output plain text.
{"customer_messages": ["I want to cancel all of my pending orders.", "My name is Yara Muller, ZIP 85041.", "I ordered them by mistake."]}

function.name: update_cancel_goal
function.description: Record the current requested cancellation scope. This does not cancel or authorize anything. Use none when cancellation is withdrawn or not requested.

arguments.source_quote: I want to cancel all of my pending orders.
